interpretation: Preferred is a recommendation among feasible options after applying the supplied capacity gate. For singleton or capacity-forced decisions, abstain from estimating comparative organizational judgment. Obligation label sets are alternative acceptable descriptions of supported work and next steps; ordering within a set has no meaning. Proposed products are not achieved outcomes.
